reuse.why: Linking reuses assertBankAccountNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank and linkBankSyncAccount, but the transaction download and initial-balance computation are copied from Akahu instead of sharing a generic provider download.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions (only URL and log text differ) and the new 'fintegra' balance branch in processBankSyncDownload duplicates the Akahu branch.

placement.why: Each piece lands where the tree keeps it: link handler in accounts/app.ts, download and balance in accounts/sync.ts, server URL in server-config.ts, type in types/models.

scope.why: Focused on the provider; the two desktop-client edits are needed to keep the shared SYNC_PROVIDERS records type-complete, though the request said server side only.

maintainability.why: Follows the existing pattern so it is easy to read, but extends the per-provider copy-paste that every provider change must now touch in one more place.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Linking goes through linkBankSyncAccount and assertBankAccountNotLinked; download uses post/getServer like the other providers.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated download function and balance branch are plain copies of the Akahu ones, not disguised.
